summary: Cantuarias builds infrastructure for AI agents, wants careful limits on what they can spend, and warns that frontier labs can shape AI risk rules.

statements.quote: everyone wants agents that can make money but i’m more interested in the infrastructure that decides how they’re allowed to spend it
we’re building an internet where some of the users won’t be human
the interesting part of always-on agents isn’t that they work while you sleep, it’s that software is slowly gaining continuity
frontier AI companies have an incentive to frame AI risk in ways that make frontier-level regulation necessary
